crossRefs.note: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the…
He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

translations.web: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
translations.bsb: Can you pet him like a bird or put him on a leash for your maidens?
translations.kjv: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
translations.asv: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
